title: Range Minimum Query Using a Segment Tree
description: Implement a Segment Tree supporting point updates and range minimum queries. Operations: `UPDATE index val` (sets element at 0-based index to val) and `QUERY l r` (minimum in range [l, r]).
input_format: First line contains `n` and `m`. Second line contains `n` integers. Following `m` lines contain commands.
output_format: Outputs of QUERY separated by space.

sample_tests.explanation: Min of [0, 2] is -2. After changing index 2 to 5, min becomes 1.

hints: Build Segment Tree with 4 * N nodes.
Updates and Range Minimum Queries execute in O(log N) time.
